name: Waning Quiver
description: Seat the draw at a deeper anchor and feel the meridians open along the bow arm.

name: Waningriser
description: Look for a rim, boss or strap edge on a shield where a heavy arrow bites best.

name: Blaze Bowgrip
description: Loose a slim hardened head at a lightly armored foe with a surge of qi.

name: Thorn Limb
description: Raise the bow across the chest and brace it with the arm to take a downward cut.

name: Glint Serving
description: Hold a long draw while qi grows in the shaft and loose it at the seam of two plates.

name: Grinding Loose
description: Send an arrow at the rim of a held shield to split the boss from the arm that carries it.

name: Furrowing Riser
description: Send a shaft with qi packed along its whole length through a shield and the man behind it.

name: Tearing Vanes
description: Gather qi through a long draw and loose one arrow that opens a breach, then a second through the same gap.

name: Verity Nock
description: Raise the bow to the angle that drops the arrow on the mark and hold it for the line.

name: Novaloose
description: Draw the string smoothly while counting the paced rhythm of the line.

name: Nova Arrowrest
description: Flick the next arrow into the nock in step with the count of the rank.

name: Might Snapshot
description: Slide a pace along the line to avoid crowding the next archer.

name: Wrecking Limbtip
description: Loose arrows on a high arc at one stretch of ground in steady rhythm to hold a body of foes.

name: Harrowing Release
description: Loose arrows at three arc heights to cover a wider patch of ground at a steady pace.

name: Hoarfrost Anchor
description: Loose a very high arc so the arrow drops nearly vertical onto a foe behind cover.

name: Downpour Draw
description: Loose a continuous sheet of arrows on a high arc so they cover a wide patch of ground.

name: Daybreak Release
description: Gather qi through a long draw and loose a single arc that splits into falling shafts above the target.

name: Invigorating Vanes
description: Pack arrows by head type so the right one is under the hand without a glance.

name: Chime Loose
description: Reset the draw hand to the nock at once after every release.

name: Annealed Serving
description: Use the pause between shots to turn a blade with the bow before the next nock.

name: Silt Bowstring
description: Move in time with the line so the shooters do not crowd each other.

name: Shade Volley
description: Loose arrow after arrow without a pause, each nocked as the last leaves, to hold ground under pressure.

name: Vanestorment
description: Draw three shafts together and loose them in a fan so one is certain to find the mark.

name: Houranchor
description: Parry a close cut with the stave and loose an arrow into the opening in one motion.

name: Nova Limbtip
description: Spend the last arrow with all the qi saved from the others in one deep thrust of the bow.

name: Iron Bowstring
description: Hold the bow across the body with a veil of qi in the limbs to ward off arrows and thrown spears.

name: Verity Limb
description: Extend the qi field to the string and read its tension without touching it.

name: Blaze Anchor
description: Seat the nock inside the field so the arrow leaves at the exact moment of release.

name: Rumblevanes
description: Hold a full draw inside the qi field with no strain and loose when the target is clear.

name: Gustnock
description: Extend the field along the stave and turn a blade or arrow aside.

name: Gust Snapshot
description: Turn within the qi field to keep the shooting line as a foe circles.

name: Arrowrest Torment
description: Wrap the shaft in the qi field so it loses nothing in a crosswind and flies true.

name: Toxin Bowgrip
description: Pluck the string to send a pulse of the field into a foe's gathering technique.

name: Thorn Volley
description: Pull a thread of the field from the string to bind a foe's bow arm for a breath.

name: Severing Snapshot
description: Push the field along the shaft so it splits a shield and the guard behind it.

name: Slag Draw
description: Draw through a long gathering and loose arrows that spread within the field to cover a wide zone.

name: Vigorous Quiver
description: Raise the eye to the far mark and settle the breath so the bow arm stops moving.

name: Facet Nock
description: Draw within a long-reaching field of qi to a deeper anchor and hold.

name: Quiverthrash
description: Loose a flat fast arrow with qi along the shaft so it holds its speed at long range.

name: Vanesremedy
description: Read the wind and the field to set a small offset for a long shot.

name: Chimeriser
description: Lift the arrow with qi along its flight so it keeps height and falls hard at the end.

name: Farseeing Limbtip
description: Spread the field outward to feel the distance to a far mark through the air.

name: Stifling Release
description: Send an arrow far across a field to pin a runner's cloak to a tree.

name: Severing Bowstring
description: Send one arrow across a great span with qi enough to pierce a shield at its end.

name: Scalding Arrowrest
description: Gather qi in a long hold and loose an arrow that climbs far and falls with full weight.

name: Discerning Riser
description: Nock at the same beat as a partner so both strings loose together on a call.

name: Drawtorment
description: Count the draw aloud with a partner so two arrows leave a heartbeat apart.

name: Gust Bowgrip
description: Step in time with the paired rank so each archer keeps a clear line past the partner.

name: Torrent Limb
description: Turn the stave to cover a partner who is drawing from a flung blade.

name: Charter Draw
description: Loose arrows in alternating pairs that fall in a long stream like a river across ground.

name: Nocktorment
description: Loose one arrow at the eye line and a second at the legs in the same breath.

name: Splintering Loose
description: Draw two shafts together and loose them to two points a hand's span apart.

name: Piercing Volley
description: Send two arrows down one line in a heartbeat so the second follows through the wound of the first.

name: Furrowing Nock
description: Gather qi through a paired draw and loose a spread of arrows that falls across a wide zone.

name: Rousing Riser
description: Narrow the eyes and spread the field outward to hold one far point in clear focus.

name: Renewing Serving
description: Judge a near and a far mark at once and prepare a draw for each.

name: Hoarfrost Vanes
description: Draw slowly with the field spread to a hawk's perch height above the line.

name: Cleaving Draw
description: Turn between a near mark and a far mark with one draw and loose at either.

name: Vanesspurt
description: Slide sideways like a hawk banking and keep the bow level as a foe turns.

name: Scything Anchor
description: Loose a steep arrow that drops on a mark from a hawk's height with hardened qi.

name: Shadeanchor
description: Loose arrows alternately at near and far ground to hold a column in two places.

name: Suppressing Release
description: Pin a fleeing foe's sleeve to a post at long range with a feathered arrow.

name: Iron Loose
description: Send one arrow far along the hawk line with qi enough to open a shield at its end.

name: Vanesassault
description: Gather qi in a long hold and loose two arrows that fall together from a hawk's height.

name: Mightloose
description: Set the feet on a muddy bank and brace so the shot does not slide.

name: Chimelimb
description: Read a mist line over a river to find the far bank and mark the range.

name: Rupturing Serving
description: Loose on the spotter's call without seeing the target and hit it by the call alone.

name: Waning Arrowrest
description: Pass arrows between partners without a pause so neither runs short in a long exchange.

name: Intentlimb
description: Loose arrows in a steady line across a river to keep a force from landing.

name: Nockthrash
description: Loose arrows from a basin rim in a falling stream onto ground below.

name: Paralyzing Snapshot
description: Pin a boat's rope to a post on the far bank with a cord arrow.

name: Tempered Quiver
description: Send an arrow along the water line with qi to pierce a boat's side at long range.

name: Splintering Nock
description: Gather qi in a paired draw and loose a broad spread over water to stop a crossing.

name: Invigorating Quiver
description: Keep armor-piercing arrows in one quiver and light arrows in the other and draw from either by feel.

name: Vanes Maelstrom
description: Switch between the two quivers without breaking the draw rhythm.

name: Rupturing Limbtip
description: Reach to the high quiver for a bodkin arrow at a beat's notice.

name: Facetriser
description: Pull a light arrow from the low quiver for a fast follow-up shot.

name: Intentdraw
description: Loose a light arrow to draw a guard and a bodkin arrow into the opening in one beat.

name: Volley Torment
description: Loose an arrow trailing a thin cord and pull it back with qi to reuse the shaft.

name: Ponderous Anchor
description: Alternate light and heavy arrows at one patch of ground in a steady stream.

name: Needling Riser
description: Send a light arrow to open a shield and a bodkin arrow after it through the gap.

name: Limb Torment
description: Gather qi with a pair of arrows and loose a spreading burst of shafts over a wide zone.

name: Might Arrowrest
description: Set the feet on the edge of a drop and balance against a strong gust without leaning.

name: Waningvanes
description: Read the bearing of the wind from grass, cloth and the string's sway before the draw.

name: Glint Bowgrip
description: Set the aim upwind of the mark to allow for a hard crosswind and loose.

name: Chimequiver
description: Hold the draw while the field settles on a bearing and loose at the lull.

name: Thorn Bowgrip
description: Crouch behind the bow and field to take a gust of grit and thrown stone.

name: Novadraw
description: Loose a shaft that rides the gale and curves into the target along the bearing.

name: Chimenock
description: Hold full draw through a gust and loose in the first lull with field-driven accuracy.

name: Trouncing Anchor
description: Loose arrows across open plateau ground in a long stream that the wind carries on.

name: Grinding Snapshot
description: Send one arrow along a held bearing with the wind behind it and qi enough to pierce a shield.

name: Anchorthrash
description: Gather qi in a long hold and loose arrows that spread on the gale across a wide field.

name: Discerning Limbtip
description: Plant the feet and speak the short oath to settle the breath and the mind before the draw.

name: Gustquiver
description: Draw with the wind at the back and hold to the oath's count.

name: Rumble Volley
description: Loose a flat arrow at plateau range with qi to hold it against the wind.

name: Equipoise Limb
description: Turn the stave to cover a sworn comrade who is drawing from a flung blade.

name: Loosebarrage
description: Loose arrows in a line with sworn comrades in a long wind-borne stream over open ground.

name: Nockplating
description: Pin a rider's cloak to the ground with an arrow along a taken bearing.

name: Hoarfrost Riser
description: Loose across a flank so the arrow curves into a foe who has not turned.

name: Scalding Vanes
description: Send a heavy arrow along the oath's bearing with qi in the head to pierce shield and mail.

name: Daybreak Quiver
description: Gather qi in a long hold with comrades and loose a falling spread of arrows on the wind.

name: Remnant Bowstring
description: Face the mark and take its bearing with the whole field before lifting the bow.

name: Cleaving Serving
description: Draw to a full anchor with the field spread to the wind and hold.

name: Splitting Release
description: Loose the arrow along the held bearing with no change in the grip.

name: Siltvanes
description: Step along the wind's push and keep the bow level while the field keeps its line.

name: Equipoise Nock
description: Turn the stave across the gust to knock a blade aside.

name: Nova Limb
description: Lock the bearing in the field and loose an arrow that holds it through a gale.

name: Toxin Bowstring
description: Pluck the string to ripple the field and break a foe's drawing technique.

name: Intent Arrowrest
description: Loose arrows on the wind across a long stretch of open ground.

name: Facet Draw
description: Send an arrow along a held bearing with the wind and field behind it to pierce a shield.

name: Unmaking Quiver
description: Gather the field in a long hold and loose arrows that spread on the gale over a wide zone.

name: Verity Limbtip
description: Probe the rock face with the toe to find a sound foothold before drawing.

name: Glint Volley
description: Draw to a low anchor to keep the body tucked against the rock while the wind pulls.

name: Nova Release
description: Raise the aim to allow for the updraft along the cliff and loose with qi in the shaft.

name: Surging Riser
description: Slide down a slope on the heels to a new firing perch.

name: Scything Snapshot
description: Loose a diving arrow along the cliff face to rake a ledge below with qi at the head.

name: Vanes Greave
description: Pin a climber's rope to the rock with an arrow to stop his ascent.

name: Granite Bowgrip
description: Brace behind a ledge and use the bow and qi to shield from stone and arrow.

name: Glint Loose
description: Send an arrow along the cliff's updraft with qi enough to pierce shield and mail.

name: Siltloose
description: Gather qi in a long hold and loose a spread of arrows that shatter stone and spray splinters below.
